<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the only signal in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm) is at 26.41 ppm. The other low-field signals (36‑38 ppm) correspond to methylene or other carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl group.</thought>
